recipient.message29_state: Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:9226-9237,9476-9690 (VA 0x479e70). Rebuilds viewer rows from the existing m_itemInfo description plus pet summary; writes/uses petName, modified, level, fullness, relationship and ITID. recipient.message24_interaction: Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:9335-9374. On a normal item detail update, if same item name/refine/slots and val2==0, it deletes/closes window and returns before touching pet fields. Otherwise it sets ONLY m_petLevel=-1 before replacing m_itemInfo (including delete time), resizing, and rebuilding item detail. Other pet fields/name/modified/ITID are not reset by message24, but level sentinel suppresses summary rows. Thus message29 can reuse item data already on the owner; message24 causes later item content to coexist with stale pet fields only behind sentinel.
recipient.coexistence: SendMsg(29) begins with ITEM_INFO::GetDescription(&m_itemInfo), then appends pet rows; it does not clear m_itemInfo/item bitmap. It repopulates text viewer, so pet summary overlays/replaces viewer lines while preserving underlying item detail data. A subsequent message24 replaces item data and clears petLevel sentinel. An equal-item message24 with val2=0 closes owner before reset.
recipient.graphics: Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:23130-23200; OnDraw draws shared item background, existing item bitmap and item text/socket rows. Pet text rows are rendered by the UITextViewer child. Keep the normal item-detail visual path intact.

source_summary_rows.description_append_details: SendMsg(29) obtains ITEM_INFO::GetDescription(&m_itemInfo) before building pet rows, but appends its elements only after the six pet rows. It also repositions m_cardItemButton by IsCardItem(m_itemInfo item-name ID), invalidates, and calls MakeTopLayer. It does not rewrite m_itemInfo, m_itemBmp, or parent dimensions.

window_height_cases.new_factory_owner_no_prior_item: MakeWindow(factory12) creates UIItemCollectionWnd at 280x120; constructor m_petLevel=-1, empty m_itemInfo. First property message29 fills pet state and produces the six pet rows, then appends current item description vector (the zero/default item resolves the null unidentified description; expected no description rows). It does not resize. This is the native pure-pet summary path.
window_height_cases.existing_ordinary_item_detail: Parent retains current height, normally 120. Message29 preserves item detail state and bitmap, and uses its description rows after the six pet rows. No resize occurs.
window_height_cases.existing_slotted_item_detail: Message24 previously sets parent to 149 when identified, slot count positive and not manufactured (the existing source predicate); message29 leaves parent at 149, leaves socket drawing data intact, and appends the current item description. It does not resize parent or child viewer. Source viewer was created at 182x80 from initial 280x120 OnCreate and is not resized by message24/29; parent slot row is painted by OnDraw from retained m_itemInfo.
window_height_cases.existing_same_item_request_caveat: A later normal message24 for the same item name/refine/four slots with val2==0 closes/deletes owner before pet-level sentinel reset. Otherwise message24 sets only m_petLevel=-1, replaces item data and uses normal 120/149 sizing. The stale other pet fields are hidden by level sentinel.
